name: fklua-gctail
title: FkLua Lua-GC tail probe
author: FkLua
description: Holds a configurable vector of live Lua array tables and lets Factorio's own --benchmark-verbose luaGarbageIncremental characterise the collector's tail against heap size, table count and collectgarbage pacing independently. Not a real mod; used only to calibrate agents/guests.md's cost table.
